0.q: Mac 上最好的 TimeBolt 替代品是什么?
0.a: AutoTrim 是专为 Mac(和 Windows)打造的 TimeBolt 替代品:并行处理所有片段而不是一次一个,导出一条合并的时间线而不是每个片段一个 XML。可免费试用、无限预览——只有导出时才需要付费(每月 $15、每年 $119 或终身 $149)。

1.q: AutoTrim 和 TimeBolt 的主要区别是什么?
1.a: 工作流程。TimeBolt 一次导入并处理一个片段,每个片段导出一个 XML,之后你必须在剪辑软件里手动合并。AutoTrim 一次接收整批素材,并行处理并导出一条已组装好的 XML 或 FCPXML 时间线。对于六个片段的拍摄,这就是手动拼六条时间线和导入一条的区别。

2.q: TimeBolt 会把所有片段合并成一条时间线吗?
2.a: 不会。TimeBolt 每个片段导出一个 XML 文件,你需要在 Final Cut Pro、Premiere Pro 或 Resolve 中手动合并。AutoTrim 为整批素材导出一条合并好的时间线,顺序已排好,可直接剪辑。

3.q: AutoTrim 比手动剪静音快多少?
3.a: 在实测案例中,清理 30 分钟口播素材手动剪切约需 48 分钟,AutoTrim 约需 1 分钟——快约 48 倍,节省 96% 的粗剪时间。

4.q: AutoTrim 支持 Final Cut Pro 吗?
4.a: 支持。AutoTrim 导出的 FCPXML 可直接导入 Final Cut Pro——这很关键,因为 FCP 没有内置静音移除功能,也没有插件市场。它还为 Premiere Pro 和 DaVinci Resolve 导出 XML。

0.q: AutoCut 支持 Final Cut Pro 吗?
0.a: 不支持。AutoCut 是 Premiere Pro 和 DaVinci Resolve 的插件——不存在 Final Cut Pro 版 AutoCut,因为 FCP 没有插件市场。AutoTrim 是独立应用,因此可以配合 Final Cut Pro 使用:导出 FCPXML 时间线,直接导入你的项目。

1.q: AutoTrim 和 AutoCut 有什么区别?
1.a: AutoCut 是运行在 Premiere Pro 或 DaVinci Resolve 内部的插件。AutoTrim 是独立桌面应用,在素材进入剪辑软件之前完成清理:并行处理所有片段,用本地 AI 移除静音和口头语,并导出一条合并时间线,支持 Final Cut Pro、Premiere 和 Resolve。它还提供 $149 一次性终身许可,而不是只有订阅。

2.q: 使用 AutoTrim 需要订阅吗?
2.a: 不需要。免费版可无限处理和预览。导出时间线可选:每月 $15、每年 $119,或 $149 一次性终身许可(首发价,原价 $279)——附 14 天退款保证。

3.q: 我的素材会上传到云端吗?
3.a: 不会。AutoTrim 的 AI 转录完全在你的电脑上运行。不上传任何内容,可离线使用,客户素材保持机密。

4.q: 用了 AutoTrim 还能继续在 Premiere Pro 里剪辑吗?
4.a: 当然。AutoTrim 只负责粗剪:移除素材中的静音和口头语,并导出 XML 时间线给 Premiere Pro(FCPXML 给 Final Cut Pro,XML 给 Resolve)。精剪仍在你的剪辑软件中完成,和以前一样。

3.q: AutoTrim 比 Descript 便宜吗?

0.q: Final Cut Pro 有内置的静音移除功能吗?
0.a: 没有。截至 2026 年,Final Cut Pro 没有检测和移除静音的原生功能,也没有插件市场可以添加。静音只能用切割工具手动剪——或者用 AutoTrim 这样的独立应用自动移除,它导出的 FCPXML 时间线可直接导回 FCP。

1.q: 如何在 Final Cut Pro 中自动移除静音?
1.a: 使用在素材进入 FCP 之前处理它们的独立工具。用 AutoTrim:把所有片段拖进应用,选择预设(YouTube、播客或 Vlog)或调整静音阈值和余量,预览剪切点,然后导出一条 FCPXML 时间线并导入 Final Cut Pro。清理 30 分钟素材约需 1 分钟。

2.q: Final Cut Pro 能移除"嗯""呃"等口头语吗?
2.a: 原生不行——FCP 没有基于转录的剪辑。AutoTrim 通过本地 AI 转录检测口头语和停顿,并可自动剪掉。该功能仍处于实验阶段,效果因语言和口音而异。

3.q: 为什么没有 Final Cut Pro 的静音移除插件?
3.a: Final Cut Pro 支持特效插件(FxPlug),但不支持能分析素材并剪切时间线的工作流插件——这就是 AutoCut 这类工具只有 Premiere Pro 和 DaVinci Resolve 版本的原因。业内通行的解决方案是用独立应用生成 FCPXML 时间线,这正是 AutoTrim 的做法。

4.q: 在 Final Cut Pro 中手动剪静音要花多长时间?
4.a: 实测案例:30 分钟口播素材约需 48 分钟的切割工具操作。AutoTrim 处理同样的素材约需 1 分钟——快约 48 倍,节省 96% 的粗剪时间。

5.q: AutoTrim 是原生 Mac 应用吗?
5.a: 是的。AutoTrim 在 macOS 上原生运行(也支持 Windows),主要为 Final Cut Pro 剪辑师打造。免费版可无限处理和预览;导出需要许可证——每月 $15、每年 $119 或终身 $149。

hero.title: Cuts the silences. And the ums.
hero.body: AutoTrim reads your footage on your machine, takes out the silences and the hesitations, and hands back a Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve timeline where every cut is still yours. Several cameras and mics? They line themselves up.
hero.capsuleTitle: An hour of footage. Thirty seconds.

silences.title: Silences go first.
silences.body: The threshold sets itself for each file. A margin is kept on either side of a sentence, so a cut never clips the first or last syllable. On an hour of talking-head footage, a third of it is silence.
silences.proof: Across 2,500 hours of footage run through AutoTrim, a third was silence.
silences.screenshot: Screenshot A · the finished session screen: cut cards, hatched bands, stat cards (05-complete)

hesitations.title: Um.
hesitations.body: A model trained to spot hesitations, not a transcript bent to the task: it hears the drawn-out "uhh", the "hmm", the word picked up again. Every hesitation is marked on the timeline, you see it, you hear it, it goes. All on your machine, nothing uploaded.
hesitations.proof: 123 hesitations removed from the real hour

multicam.title: Three cameras, two mics, one drop.
multicam.body: Drop every file of one take. They find each other by their sound and line up to the frame, even when a camera started late, split into two files or drifts. One mic per person: a cut only when nobody speaks, never two voices at once, and one person's "um" only goes if the other is silent. The edit follows who's talking, wide shot when everyone does.

capsules.drop: Three cameras, two mics, one drop.

multicam.truth: The exported timeline stacks the angles: V1 for the main angle, the others above it, one track per mic, all cut at the same instants. In Resolve, Final Cut and Premiere.
multicam.quote: I record 2–3 hour podcast episodes with multiple guests. AutoTrim saves me at least 2 hours of editing per episode.

timeline.title: Your timeline, not our export.
timeline.body: One timeline, all your files end to end, in Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Nothing is erased: every clip keeps its handles, drag an edge to bring a breath back. AutoTrim doesn't edit for you, it preps the cut.
timeline.quote: Nothing is erased: every clip keeps its handles.
timeline.quoteSource: The app's export menu, word for word.
timeline.screenshot: Screenshot B · the export menu open on Timeline · Final Cut Pro (05b-export-menu)

preview.title: Watch before you export.
preview.body: Playback skips the cuts without a stutter. The timeline shows three states: kept, silence, hesitation. Not sure? Listen to what was removed, adjust the threshold, run again. Don't edit? Take the video already cut, one MP4 per source, or one clip per cut.
preview.quote: Super intuitive, with previews that help a lot.
preview.screenshot: Screenshot C · a file's preview, three-state timeline, Cut 19:25 counter (04-preview)

items.q: Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve?
items.a: Yes: FCPXML for Final Cut Pro and Resolve, XML for Premiere Pro. One timeline, all your files end to end, every clip with its handles.

items.q: Do my files leave my computer?
items.a: No, never. The models download once, then everything happens on your machine, even offline.

items.q: What if it cuts too much?
items.a: The preview shows three states, kept, silence, hesitation, and you can listen to what was removed. Adjust the threshold, run again, then export: every cut stays editable in your editing software.

items.q: My podcast has one mic per person?
items.a: Yes. AutoTrim only cuts when nobody speaks, never two voices at once, and one person's "um" only goes if the other is silent.
Drop every file of one take: they line up to the frame by their sound. The timeline stacks the angles, and the preview shows the edit following who's talking.

items.q: Which languages are hesitations detected in?

items.q: Screen recordings (OBS, VLC, QuickTime), variable frame rate?
items.a: Supported. The real duration is kept, so the timeline lands right.
